Älykello tai sormessa komeileva älysormus on muuttunut tavanomaiseksi näyksi. items.title: Insecure Default Policy and Unrestricted OIDC Enrollment in Google OSS Agent Mesh (SAM)
items.summary: Classification: Critical, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Proof-of-Concept, CVSSv4.0: 9.3, CVEs: CVE-2026-103091, Summary: SAM's MCP proxy has no authorization. Any authenticated mesh member can invoke any tool on any node, with full read/write/exec on the backend. The only prerequisite is the control plane URL (via Shodan, I currently found a few via a header, but since this project is still in its very early adoption stage it makes sense the numbers aren't big right now, it's got like 700 stars on GH). From there, the control plane hands over everything needed to join the mesh.

items.title: The Evolving Cybersecurity Lexicon: Vulnerability Discovery to Resilience
items.summary: Every year, the lexicographers at Merriam-Webster officially add new words or word usage to the dictionary. It's a fascinating process, outlined here. And, in 2025, the word "slop" was amended to include AI slop, mass quantities of content created using generative AI. Watching our language and usage evolve gives us a glimpse into the zeitgeist. items.summary: KUN tulin valituksi kansanedustajaksi vuonna 1995, Pirkanmaa oli jo vahva maakunta, ja on ollut hienoa nähdä sen kehittyminen yhdeksi koko Suomen merkittävimmistä ja vetovoimaisimmista maakunnista.
